subject: Prioritizing CloudWave co-sell demo — ops priority queue arbitration
messages:
From: Maya Shah <maya@cloudwave.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudWave Partner Success <partner-success@cloudwave.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to move co-sell demo earlier this week

Hi Jordan —

Hope you’re well. Quick ask: our VP of GTM (and one of the execs who will sign off on the marketplace purchase) will be in town and has a 90-minute window this Friday afternoon. They asked if we can move the already-scheduled co-sell demo with Redwood up by 48 hours so they can join live.

We understand this is short notice — we’d like to prioritize the slot if it’s possible because the exec’s availability is hard to come by. If you can’t do that, would you propose two earlier alternatives next week?

I attached the updated mutual action plan and a small availability grid from our side for reference (mutual-action-plan.xlsx, availability-grid.png).

Thanks — Maya
Partner Lead | CloudWave
maya@cloudwave.com
--
Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: availability-grid.png (image)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request to move co-sell demo earlier this week

Kimberly / Ben — forwarding Maya’s ask from CloudWave. Short notice exec availability Friday afternoon — they want an earlier demo to get sign-off.

Constraints to consider:
- Current booking is Fri 29 Oct 16:30 PT on the public marketplace demo calendar (was provisionally set as co-sell runthrough + marketplace checklist).
- If we move, we need AWS Marketplace ops on the line to finalize listing changes and ensure recording capture for listing materials.
- We have two engineers on rotation that week; might need to swap Ben’s on-call host with someone else if we agree to a shift.

Quick proposal:
1) Option A (priority): Move to Thu 28 Oct 14:00–15:00 PT — requires Ben to cover ops, Kimberly to own GTM slate.
2) Option B: Keep Fri 29 Oct but shift earlier to 13:30–14:30 PT (less disruptive to on-call).
3) Option C: Next Tues 2 Nov 09:00–10:00 PT as fallback.

I’ll hold the priority slot tentatively for 24 hours if CloudWave confirms. Ben — can you check if you can backfill host duties Thursday? KB — can you confirm if you or someone from GTM can lead the exec portion if we move?

Jordan Blake
Principal Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment referenced: mutual-action-plan.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request to move co-sell demo earlier this week

Quick update — I can rearrange the on-call swap with Diego to free up Thu 28 Oct 14:00 PT. I’ll need Ben.CoverSwap calendar invite to be processed and I’ll confirm the host runbook.

Notes / ops ask for CloudWave/AWS:
- We need the Marketplace ops contact on the thread so they can sign off on the change to the listing metadata and confirm the recording capture.
- If we move to Thu, please make sure the execs can join the first 20 minutes for the topline then we’ll deep-dive for the remainder.

I’m good with Option A as priority. Jordan — I’ll put a tentative hold and update the runbook.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: runbook-change-log.txt (small text file)

From: Maya Shah <maya@cloudwave.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudWave Partner Success <partner-success@cloudwave.com>, AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to move co-sell demo earlier this week

Thanks everyone — we can take Option A (Thu 28 Oct 14:00–15:00 PT). Confirmed the VP can attend first 40 minutes.

AWS Marketplace Ops team — tagging you to ensure the listing amendment and recording pipeline are okay with the adjusted time. We’ll update HubSpot and pull the new meeting recording for the marketplace materials.

Jordan / Ben / Kimberly — I uploaded the signed MPA addendum and updated the Deal in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/rdw-3481. Please confirm you have what you need from us to lock the slot; we will send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Maya
